obligations.expected_behavior: Every external process completes within its applicable time bound.
forbidden_result: An external process exceeds its time bound.
An external process remains running without a bounded terminal outcome.
obligations.observable_result: For each external process execution, recorded elapsed time is at or below the applicable bound.
obligations.state_after: The external process has completed within its applicable time bound.
obligations.state_before: An external process is executing with a time bound applicable.
obligations.subject: Each external process

obligations.expected_behavior: Every external process produces output within its applicable output bound.

obligations.state_before: An external process is executing with an output bound applicable.

obligations.expected_behavior: Every external process reaches a deterministic terminal state when it terminates.
forbidden_result: An external process terminates in an indeterminate state.

obligations.state_after: The external process is in a deterministic terminal state.
obligations.state_before: An external process is executing and has not reached a terminal state.

obligations.expected_behavior: When any applicable time or output budget is exhausted, the execution is unsuccessful.
forbidden_result: Budget exhaustion is reported as success.
Budget exhaustion leaves the execution pending or ambiguously classified.
obligations.observable_result: An execution that exhausts a budget has a terminal outcome explicitly marked unsuccessful.
obligations.state_after: The budget-exhausted execution has an unsuccessful terminal outcome.
obligations.state_before: An external process or aggregate is executing while its applicable budget remains available.
obligations.subject: Any external process or aggregate
obligations.trigger: An applicable time or output budget is exhausted.
